name: PR-Agent
tagline: Community-maintained, MIT-licensed PR reviewer with /review, /describe, and /improve commands, self-hosted with your own model keys.
pricing: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only infrastructure and LLM API usage at provider list price. Transferred from Qodo to a community org in 2026
selfHostedNote: Runs as a CLI, Docker container, GitHub Action, or persistent webhook server on your own infrastructure.
modelControl: Full BYOK via LiteLLM: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter, local Ollama

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Per-PR review only; no codebase index or cross-repo context (per our open-source guide).

02-rule-centric.note: Configurable via TOML with your own conventions; no rule management UI or plain-language rules.

03-dual-workflow.note: Runs as CLI locally, in CI, or as PR commands; no distinct local-vs-PR behavior modes documented.

04-business-logic.note: Ticket-compliance features not covered in the sources we verified.

05-continuous-learning.note: No learning from review history (per our open-source guide).

06-sandbox-validation.note: Static per-PR analysis; no sandbox execution or test-run validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: MIT-licensed BYOK via LiteLLM; pay providers at list price with full model choice, incl. local Ollama.

08-actionability.note: /improve generates code suggestions on the PR; apply flow varies by platform.

09-measurable-roi.note: No dashboards or metrics (per our open-source guide).
